<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def get_blue_positions(frame):
    seg = frame.segmentation
    positions = []
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        if n['color'] == 'S':
            positions.append((n['boundary'][0][0], n['boundary'][0][1]))
    positions.sort()
    return tuple(positions)

current_pos = get_blue_positions(current_frame)
